scenes.caption: Run your agents on Claude Code, on Cursor, or both: two full teams, one box.

scenes.visual: Two animated bars: Python about 69 ms against Go about 8 ms.

scenes.caption: Every role ships with its own skills: coders self-review, reviewers look from several angles, researchers follow a benchmark protocol. Setup is one command.

scenes.caption: Put recurring work on a schedule, with a token cap on every run.
onscreen: up to 5 recurring jobs · token cap per run
